author: OpenAI
description:
Builders Unscripted spotlights the stories behind real projects and the mindset that makes them possible: you can just build things. 

In this episode, Romain Huet, Head of Developer Experience, chats with Ashe Magalhaes, founder of Hearth AI. Ashe talks about moving fast with Codex, finding beauty in tools, and gives a keen look into her agentic personal operating systems that enable her to feel more present, connected, and intentional.

Chapters:
00:00 Intro
00:10 Early agents and Hearth AI
05:43 AI and human connection
08:44 Build in public
12:17 Ashe’s agentic workflow
title: Builders Unscripted: Ep. 2 - Ashe Magalhaes, Founder of Hearth AI
